_comment: Crossing: how a reviewed plan is run against the target. Read at the start of every run. See docs/CROSSING.md and docs/PROCEEDING_WITHOUT_ANSWERS.md.
_pilotContracts: The first contracts of every run are a pilot: the run pauses after them until someone reviews and continues.

resultIds._comment: Where each operation's response carries the new ID. The vendor samples show 'id' for signatory groups; contract and user responses are not in the samples, so likely names are tried in order and read-back looks the ID up when none is found.

_noIdNeeded: Approval calls answer without an ID (vendor samples); they are recorded as done and read-back proves them.
_alreadyDone: Error codes that mean the target is already in the wanted state: UpdateApprovalMatrixMode refuses a mode the contract already has (10205, 'isGroupMatrix flag is same as the input').

readBack._comment: Read-only checks after each call, in the shape the product itself stores (docs/PROCEEDING_WITHOUT_ANSWERS.md). Parameters: :id (the new ID), every field of the request (IDs already filled in), :accountCount and :signatoryCount. 'lookup' finds the ID when the response has none or the call timed out; it must return exactly one row.

CreateContract.lookup: SELECT contractId FROM contractcorecustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :primaryCif

verify.label: Contract exists
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE id = :id

verify.label: Primary CIF is on the contract
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contractcorecustomers WHERE contractId = :id AND coreCustomerId = :primaryCif

verify.label: Every account is on the contract
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contractaccounts WHERE contractId = :id

verify.label: Login exists
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE id = :id

verify.label: Login is on the contract
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contractcustomers WHERE contractId = :contractId AND customerId = :id

verify.label: Login exists
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE id = :id

verify.label: Login is on the contract
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contractcustomers WHERE contractId = :contractId AND customerId = :id

CreateSignatoryGroup.lookup: SELECT signatoryGroupId FROM signatorygroup WHERE contractId = :contractId AND signatoryGroupName = :signatoryGroupName

verify.label: Group exists
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signatorygroup WHERE signatoryGroupId = :id

verify.label: Every member is in the group
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customersignatorygroup WHERE signatoryGroupId = :id

verify.label: Mode stored for the contract and customer
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approvalmode WHERE contractId = :contractId AND coreCustomerId = :cif AND isGroupLevel = :isGroupLevel

verify.label: One stored range per range sent
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approvalmatrix WHERE contractId = :contractId AND coreCustomerId = :cif AND actionId = :actionId AND limitTypeId = :limitTypeId AND accountId = :accountKey AND softdeleteflag = 0

verify.label: No-approval ranges stored as NO_APPROVAL
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approvalmatrix WHERE contractId = :contractId AND coreCustomerId = :cif AND actionId = :actionId AND limitTypeId = :limitTypeId AND accountId = :accountKey AND softdeleteflag = 0 AND approvalruleId = 'NO_APPROVAL'

verify.label: Group conditions stored for group ranges
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signatorygroupmatrix s JOIN approvalmatrix a ON a.id = s.approvalMatrixId WHERE a.contractId = :contractId AND a.coreCustomerId = :cif AND a.actionId = :actionId AND a.limitTypeId = :limitTypeId AND a.accountId = :accountKey AND a.softdeleteflag = 0 AND s.softdeleteflag = 0
